V4-M1: cohort-projection-set must be a closed, unsigned, domain-separated derived record over the EXACT ordered complete member projection references. No signature/signer/key/grant fields or root-fence producer role on this derived set; remove it from signing/trust-role registries and classify it explicitly as DERIVED_DIGEST, never an attestation/proof/trust anchor. Compute SHA256(unique derived-domain + NUL + accepted C2 canonical body bytes without body newline), with generated closed-schema and byte/ordering vectors. Root-fence retains only its separately specified genuine fence/lease authority; no signing Node-produced/derivable state. Verifier must INDEPENDENTLY validate each referenced current Node projection and its original authority/context before deriving the set; never accept a supplied digest/set as evidence by itself. Document exact producer/custody/dataflow and all API/journal uses of expected prior set digest; keep per-member and cohort prior-reference fields explicit, no PC2 fallback or single member stand-in.
V4-I1: bind the derived set itself to exact plan/cohort membership/order, operation, fence epoch, lease envelope, current inventory head/readback and BOTH prior Node projections. Cross-context/lease/head/epoch/omission/duplicate/reorder swaps must fail after recomputing every dependent payload hash. This context binding is identity/CAS comparison, not independent authority.
V4-I2: every explicit UNTRUSTED synthetic signer public-key hash/role must agree with its published dummy policy mapping and Node/role scope. Use distinct Node fixture keys/identifiers and distinguish their dummy signature bytes; no shared A/B signer that hides cross-Node/role substitutions. Keep signatures clearly synthetic/not cryptographically verified, or publish separately labeled test-only crypto evidence if actually executed; never invent production key provenance or actual runtime/signature acceptance. Add key/role/Node swapping negatives under recomputed hashes.
V4-I3: if original pre-prune SYNTHETIC seed bytes survive, publish their immutable bytes/hash alongside final seed and102input-pointer equivalence. If unavailable, preserve the historical owner assertion but explicitly mark pre-prune equivalence UNVERIFIED/unreproducible from published evidence; do not recreate and label guessed bytes original. Final published195object graph byte-regeneration is separate valid evidence.
Regenerate graph/coverage/proof-vs-derived classification/reference hashes and all stateful scenarios; adjust counts honestly rather than carrying112signedproofs across unsigned conversion. Preserve original errors and actual closed Low results. Every real target/Root/member/trust binding NULL/HOLD, actualGo/Engine/OSlock/atomicity/equipment0 and40future product casesNOTRUN.
